findings.claim: Declared (SKILL.md:80): "The description names exactly what the filter passes." Practiced (SKILL.md:76-77): description is "stalls, deviations, no record copy, CI"; the same Monitor grep also passes "harness gone" and "watchdog error", which the description does not name. Round-1 ee08a7#2 (CI missing from a recipe that advertised CI) is fixed — forge stays on and `ci fail `|`ci cancel ` match — but the repair added an exact-match sentence that is still false.
findings.reproduce:

text=Path('.claude/skills/watch/SKILL.md').read_text()

findings.claim: Declared (cf067ff4): "935 rows, 47 lines added since the last export. Eight of those are this branch's; the other 39 belong to nine review records the same regeneration carries, four of which are not on this branch yet." Practiced: 935 and +47 hold, and the eight ee08a7+61ba2a rows are this branch's; the other 39 rows belong to 7 records, not 9. Six of those 7 have no record file on this branch or on origin/dev 46639344; only 20260916T030018Z-review-grok-df544a is already on trunk. The file itself is a real `findings.py export --write` (ORDER BY record, n; sort_keys), not a hand edit.
findings.reproduce:
python3 - <<'PY'
import json, subprocess, collections
from pathlib import Path
diff=subprocess.check_output(['git','diff','a663b79b','cf067ff4','--','ops/conductor/findings/findings.jsonl'], text=True)

assert len(added)==47 and sum(1 for _ in Path('ops/conductor/findings/findings.jsonl').open())==935

assert sum(by[r] for r in this)==8 and len(by)==9
other=[r for r in by if r not in this]
